newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-AUSTRALIA 10-YR BOND TESTING FAMILIAR AREA.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-AUSTRALIA 10-YR BOND TESTING FAMILIAR AREA.

text.p: *The Australian 10-year bond futures contract was heading back to familiar support at around 93.500 at the close of the SYCOM session after failing to progress a rally beyond 93.600.
*The contract needs to hold 93.400 to keep uptrend intact.
*U.S. Treasuries ended lower after 30-year bond sale.
The September Australian 10-year bond futures contract was heading back to a familiar support area at around 93.500 at the close of the SYCOM session after failing to progress a rally beyond 93.600.
The contract ended the after hours session at 93.525 compared with Thursday's pit close of 93.545 and hovering just above an initial support zone of 93.500/93.510.
Peter Pontikis, technical strategist at Westpac Banking Corporation, expects the contract to ease a further five or so basis points to a firmer support level at 93.470.

Domestic housing finance data for June are due at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT). Median expections are for a 2.5 percent rise after the 8.4 percent drop in May, although forecasts were fairly wide ranging from an 8.0 percent increase to a 9.0 percent fall, according to a Reuters survey of economists.
